name: Chapter 29B, Article 1. Public Records.
scope: article W. Va. Code ch. 29B art. 1 (West Virginia Legislature, article PDFs)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote_through: The court shall determine the matter de novo and the burden is on the public body to sustain its action.

access.label: The person can see the record
access.quote_through: Any person who is denied access to public records requested pursuant to this article and who successfully brings a suit filed pursuant to section five of this article shall be entitled to recover his or her attorney fees and court costs from the public body that denied him or her

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire
waiver.quote: Provided, however, That information or other records exempted under this subdivision may be disclosed to a law-enforcement agency or officer:

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that
boundary.quote_takes: (21) Personal information of law-enforcement officers maintained by the public body in the ordinary course of the employer-employee relationship.
boundary.quote_limits: (a) Every person has a right to inspect or copy any public record of a public body in this state, except as otherwise expressly provided by section four of this article.

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it
plain-words.quote_longest: (1) Trade secrets, as used in this section, which may include, but are not limited to, any formula, plan, pattern, process, tool, mechanism, compound, procedure, production data, or compilation of information which is not patented which is known only to certain individuals within

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: A public body may not charge a search or retrieval fee or otherwise seek reimbursement based on a man-hour basis as part of costs associated with making reproduction of records.
fair-exchange.quote_gets: A public body may not charge a search or retrieval fee or otherwise seek reimbursement based on a man-hour basis as part of costs associated with making reproduction of records.
